img1.label: ok
img1.note: ố mark is a fused stroke: arch with both legs (circumflex, right leg slightly shorter) continuing into a tall rising pointed flag (acute) - handwriting-style single-stroke ố. Too tall/asymmetric for a tilde. Borderline but both components identifiable. ệ correct.

img2.label: ok
img2.note: ố: full circumflex arch (both legs) with a steep, slightly S-curved rising stroke from its right foot, flat-cut top (acute), no curl so not a hook. Borderline stylization; both components identifiable. ệ correct.

img1.label: ok
img1.note: Grave on à is a brush stroke sloping down-right with a short downward entry tick at its left end; dominant shape is grave. ộ: circumflex + dot below clear.
